name: GenCeption
description: An annotation-free multimodal LLM evaluation framework that uses unimodal data to assess inter-modality semantic coherence and hallucination tendencies through iterative description and generation steps.
reputation: A niche evaluation framework for multimodal LLM coherence and hallucination analysis that has seen research interest but limited community-wide adoption.
notes: Inspired by the DrawCeption game, it quantifies semantic drift across iterative generations without requiring annotations, enabling evaluation of multimodal LLMs.
